scope: Local Codex in-app browser review of the v0.2.0 engineering-studio Streamlit application. Numerical tests are recorded separately.
observed: Home showed four structural-family cards, current-session resume and import without running a solution.

The 1440-pixel view showed the 280-pixel sidebar and four launchpad cards. The 1024-pixel workspace used overlay navigation. The 760- and 390-pixel pages used one content column with no document-level horizontal overflow.
Define used focused category editing beside an unsolved preview, then stacked those areas on narrow screens. Input-valid and stability checks remained separate.
Understand displayed an eight-step map, progressive explanations, actual member properties, DOF maps and four matrix-laboratory views before solving.
Solve required its explicit button, then displayed complete result cards, structure and member plots, result tabs, calculation checks and limitations.
The applied-load multiplier comparison completed; releasing A:ux showed an unstable-model failure and kept the baseline.

The learning report download control was exercised. Standalone reports for bar, truss, beam and frame were regenerated and opened locally; each rendered its embedded Plotly figure, readable nodal/comparison/member tables and no external script or stylesheet links.
The stiffness study showed data origin and identifiability before complete estimate cards, prediction error, uncertainty and sensitivity details.
The glossary displayed searchable cards and Model, Mechanics, Calculation and Research filters. The compact Key terms control replaced large terminology strips.
The shared exported-report style includes a branded header, evidence label, contents, responsive tables and no external stylesheet or script asset.
Focus outlines, status words and symbols, 44-pixel controls and the reduced-motion media rule were inspected. Color was not the only status indicator.
remaining_review: Full keyboard-only navigation and Enter/Space activation was not performed; visible focus styling was inspected.
No physical touchscreen or screen-reader review was performed.
No full OS network-outage test was performed; automated app tests block Python socket access.
All four family workflows and launchpad actions are covered by automated app tests. This browser review used the axial bar for the full three-stage route.
public_release: v0.2.0 pending clean Windows, Ubuntu and independent OpenSees jobs
